Why Steve

The coach behind the plan

Steve Rose, M.S., CSCS — Assistant Performance Coach at Princeton University.

SSS COMPLETE isn't a template — it's the way Steve coaches and trains himself: teach the lifts properly, lift heavy, sprint, and repeat it long enough to get good at it. He has coached athletes from age 8 to 80, and he still trains the same way he asks his athletes to. Join the team, and you train the way he does.
